brief:
# Customer Feedback Portal

## Purpose
Collect customer feedback, validate submissions, and provide an administrative review dashboard.

## Technology and source layout
Next.js, TypeScript, and Playwright. Follow framework-native source conventions.

## Modules and constraints
Document modules, integrations, and acceptance expectations here.
projectYaml:
schemaVersion: 1
engineVersion: 0.1.0
executionPolicy: autonomous-development
bootstrapProfile: nextjs-prisma
AD_HOC_FILES: ""
requireIterationPlanReview: true
defaults:
  provider: codex-cli
  model: gpt-5.5
  reasoning: medium
  timeoutSeconds: 900
maxIterations: 3
configurationVersion: 5
enabledProcesses:
  - .ai_factory/delivery/processes/feature-delivery/0.1.yaml
  - .ai_factory/delivery/processes/multi-iteration-delivery/1.1.yaml
